company.name: InLoop Robotics
company.shortDescription: InLoop Robotics develops bimanual robotic systems and RaaS solutions for manufacturing, assembly, and logistics workflows.
company.description: InLoop Robotics develops AI-driven robotic systems that automate manual labor in manufacturing, assembly, and logistics workflows. The company offers Loop V1, an intelligent bimanual robot designed to perform warehouse and factory tasks such as box assembly, kitting, visual inspection, content preparation, and unpackaging. Its systems combine autonomous manipulation with a safety module and remote teleoperation so robots can pause and request human assistance on uncertain tasks. InLoop Robotics provides its robots as a robotics-as-a-service offering, bundling hardware, AI software, and teleoperations support for a recurring fee. Its technology is used in warehouses, fulfillment centers, and factories to handle dexterous packaging and material-handling processes.
